features.name: oc_has_concrete_example
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment explicitly reference a specific, concrete example or real-world instance?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP). Return 1 if at least one comment explicitly references a specific, concrete example or real-world instance (a named or identifiable case, event, person, product, study, place, or a specific real occurrence/personal experience) offered in support of the commenter's counter-argument; return 0 if none do (generic, abstract or purely hypothetical statements do not count). Presence only, not a count. A comment's own assertion or an external source cited as support counts; a quotation of the OP or a rebuttal quotation not adopted does not. Ignore any OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome resolution updates or reports of the outcome as evidence. Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null.

h0: oc_has_concrete_example has no association with the probability of view change (delta).
h1: Discussions with oc_has_concrete_example = 1 have a higher probability of view change than those with 0.
note: Binary presence assumed since no quantity was specified. OLS on binary delta gives a linear probability model. OC_comments is current text and may contain outcome-related content, which the prompt excludes as evidence; comment timing is unknown. Association only, not causal.
